model.basis: Minutes for a learner who has finished the six covered topic pages. Reading and writing times use the frozen page estimator rates (200 words per minute, 15 code lines per minute) for the README and worked example, plus authoring time per file judged from the size of each file in two independently written private solutions (backend Dockerfile 12-13 lines, frontend Dockerfile 8-9 lines, compose.yaml 30-40 lines).
model.wrongFirstRetry: each of the 16 tests failing once after the first attempt costs about 1 minute to read the message, fix and rerun; a typical learner meets 4 to 6 such retries, already inside phase 4
model.worstRequiredBasis: typical 75 plus about 20 minutes for every one of the five file groups failing twice before passing (two retries of about 2 minutes each per group)
model.fit: Each Standard Lab day has an 85-minute guided-lab block (frozen calendar Lab template); the S36 and S37 shares and the 95-minute worst case fit within the two blocks together

learnerCommands.note: wall-clock /usr/bin/time real seconds for the commands in lab.json; the cold run used an empty npm cache
